in_marathi.name: Dhamendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Thunder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhamendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhamendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Dhama’ meaning cosmos or universe, and ‘Andra’ meaning thunder. It is the name of the Hindu god Indra, who is considered the god of rain and thunder.
